about: Test programs that workload_fetch downloads. Each is built from source by .github/workflows/workloads.yml; its BUILD.txt lists the commits.

drawstress.title: bgfx 17-drawstress
drawstress.about: Draws a grid of cubes, dim^3 draw calls per frame (64 000 at dim 40): measures what one draw costs in native Metal and through a translation layer. Shaders are inside the program.
drawstress.license: BSD-2-Clause (bgfx, Branimir Karadzic); LICENSE-bgfx in the archive

bgfx-examples.title: bgfx examples
bgfx-examples.about: Nine of bgfx's examples, each a different load: 01-cubes and 35-dynamic (many cubes, uploads), 06-bump (textured), 09-hdr (render-target chain), 21-deferred (G-buffer and lights), 24-nbody (compute), 31-rsm (reflective shadow maps), 38-bloom (post-processing), 48-drawindirect (draws the GPU decides). Pass example to perf_record.
bgfx-examples.license: BSD-2-Clause (bgfx, Branimir Karadzic); LICENSE-bgfx in the archive
